blocks.raw: # Step 1: Set Up a Neo Transformation Endpoint
blocks.text: Step 1: Set Up a Neo Transformation Endpoint

blocks.raw: 1. [Create a transformation NEO endpoint](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/extension) that will handle the JSON transformation. This endpoint should:
blocks.text: Create a transformation NEO endpoint that will handle the JSON transformation. This endpoint should:

blocks.raw:
* Accept POST requests with JSON payload
* Transform the JSON according to your requirements
* Return the transformed JSON
